transcript: There was a water leak near Conference Room 2 around 10 AM. Maintenance has already isolated the area.

placeholders.category_list:
FIRE: flames, smoke, burning smell, explosion or blast
MEDICAL: any injury or illness to a person
WATER: water leaking or flooding indoors: pipes, roof, AC, tanks
ELECTRICAL: electric shock, sparking, short circuit, exposed wiring, overheating, power failure
HAZMAT: gas leak, chemical spill or fumes with exposure risk to people
EQUIPMENT: breakdown or malfunction of machines, tools, HVAC, pumps or other equipment
SECURITY: theft, break-in, trespass, unauthorised access, vandalism, assault, threats, suspicious activity
STRUCTURAL: damage to building or facilities, slip/trip hazards, broken glass, collapsed racks, stuck lifts
ENVIRONMENTAL: release of oil, chemicals or waste into drains, soil, water or air; abnormal emissions
VEHICLE: collisions or incidents involving forklifts, trucks, cars or bikes on premises
OTHER: anything not covered by the other categories
placeholders.severity_rubric:
CRITICAL: Life-threatening or uncontrolled: unconscious or not breathing person, fire spreading, ongoing gas or chemical release with people exposed, people trapped, structural collapse with people at risk, electrocution.
HIGH: Serious injury needing medical treatment beyond first aid; hazard active but being controlled; major damage; production stopped; assault or ongoing intrusion.
MEDIUM: Minor injury (first aid only); hazard controlled; limited damage; equipment degraded; theft without harm.
LOW: No injury and minimal damage; near miss; hazard already resolved; cosmetic issues.
